catholic-encyclopedia-1913-altamura-and-: A 1913 entry on Altamura and Acquaviva — the united Apulian diocese. The entry gives its history. Frederick II's city keeps its cathedral. The Murge hills frame its parishes. A see of the southern plain. Its bishops serve the Apulian plain. Its clergy serve the hill towns.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-antonio-canov: This 1913 reference piece on Antonio Canova — the sculptor of the neoclassical age. Marie Louise Handley praises his marble. His Three Graces charm the world. Popes' tombs bear his chisel's mark. The restorer of the antique ideal. His studio draws the Roman visitor.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-ava: This 1913 reference piece on Ava — the old Burmese capital. Arthur Remy notes its modest record. The entry preserves its scanty fame. The missions remember their stations. A station of the eastern missions. Its pagodas crowned the Irrawaddy bank. Its kings ruled the Burmese plain.
